page: Amazon Web Services t8i.micro is an entry-level burstable general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. The virtual machine executes on an x86_64 Intel processor featuring a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. It is provisioned with 2 burstable vCPUs mapped across 1 physical core using 2 threads per core, combined with 1.0 GB of system memory, providing 0.5 GB per core.

The instance contains no integrated GPUs and provides no local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operating system disks and persistent file storage. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 0 Gbps, reflecting a burst-oriented networking allocation model. Additionally, the instance is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Architecturally, the t8i.micro instance delivers low baseline resource consumption tailored for intermittent compute demands. The burstable CPU allocation model allows the system to conserve resources during idle states while serving intermittent spikes in demand. These characteristics make it suitable for non-continuous workloads, microservices, minimal test environments, and background utility scripts.
